_comment: Agent-side safety configuration, authored for this demo (not loaded into BigQuery). Consumed by the agents/ ADK service in Phase 5 to keep responses educational-only and to catch situations that need a human, not a generated answer.
educational_disclaimer: This is educational information, not a diagnosis, treatment plan, or personalized medical advice. If you're experiencing a medical emergency, contact your local emergency number.
out_of_scope_response: I can share general educational information on this topic, but I can't provide a diagnosis, treatment plan, or medication guidance. Please talk with a qualified healthcare provider about your specific situation.
escalation_response: This sounds like it could be an emergency or something that needs immediate, in-person attention. Please contact your local emergency number or go to the nearest emergency room now. If this is a mental health crisis, in the US you can call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline).
